question: Because of the course Barak took, what did Deborah say would happen?
options: The honor would not be his, because the LORD would deliver Sisera into the hands of a woman
Barak would be killed in the battle
Deborah would become queen of Israel
explanation: Deborah agreed to go, but said the honor would not be Barak's, because the LORD would deliver Sisera into the hands of a woman.
